code.originalText: Six-month review: blood pressure at goal, urine albumin, kidney function, hemoglobin, mood, and the travel season ahead

text.paragraph: Six-month review: blood pressure at goal, urine albumin, kidney function, hemoglobin, mood, and the travel season ahead. [S]

Madam Walker returns ten weeks after her preventive visit; the laboratory day was booked before her summer trips, as planned. Her home readings average 123/77 on losartan 100 mg, amlodipine 5 mg and empagliflozin 10 mg. She has had no ankle swelling, dizziness, genital itching or muscle aches. Her mammogram was normal and her HPV test and stool test were negative. Having read about APOL1 testing, she has decided not to have it for now, since it would not change her treatment; she knows it remains available. She plans an autumn of travel and asked what she should watch for on the road. [S]
